With increased flux spending, this weapon will now tax ships like Invictus or Legion more heavily. But with increased damage it will now feel far more potent against targets other than fighters. Encouraging players to use it on something like a Dominator especially with the current state of things.

Hellbore Cannon projectile speed increased by 50%
Hellbore's inability to damage shields and low DPS means that it's really easy to counter. And has been slowly falling out of existence. Quietly ignored in vanilla. With increased projectile speed and Hephaestus design changes. Hellbore is now the safer option... That also suffers from the inability to suppress its target

Assault Chaingun now has 600 range instead of 450.
Chaingun has no place in vanilla on ships other than SO ones. And it has also been ceasing to exist slowly due to the viability of Heavy Blaster against armour replacing it instead. With additional 150 range it is now extremely threatening. Being able to be equipped on something like a Falcon to tear down anything in its wake

Gauss Cannon now does 1000 damage instead of 700 per shot.
This has been done because Gauss Cannon is generally considered now the weakest weapon in the game. And it requires heavy buffs to make itself viable

Mjolnir now does 400 EMP damage instead of 200 per shot.
I was looking to buff the Mjolnir without making it overpowered. And then realised one of its most important aspects is actually irrelevant in vanilla due to how weak the actual stat is

Missile Changes

Missiles have been greatly increased in damage to make them interact with PD better and punish ships without PD significantly harder. Giving proper reasoning to buffing ships like Hyperion. Shrike. And buffing PD tools like interceptors or base PD like Vulcan. In vanilla PD is usually frowned upon to the extreme. Rendering tools like Guardian PD never seen. And constantly begged to be buffed. Especially evident with the recent Anubis blog post. I have come to a realisation that in order for PD to be actually respected. The threat they are to deal with has to be far more severe.

Harpoon now does 1000 damage instead of 750
Atropos now does 1250 damage instead of 1000
Hammer now does 2000 damage instead of 1500
Sabot now does 250x6 damage instead of 200x5

Breach now does 300 HE damage on top of their passive damage package instead of 150 HE. This will confuse the AI a lot of less

Pilum now does 500 ENERGY damage instead of FRAG. Increased base ammo capacity by a factor of 2

Reaper now does 5k damage instead of 4k. Additionally damage has been changed to Energy instead of HE to encourage shooting shields with it. And also to make it more akin to an actual nuclear warhead than an anti-shield projectile. Reaper launchers have been standardised to compensate. Cyclone no longer provides additional launch speed. And they now provide as many missiles as they have OP. 1 per 2. Cyclone now gives 13. Typhoon now gives 5

Dragonfire Torpedo launchers now have twice as much ammo. Dragon however has less 100 targeting range

Gorgon reworked. Now has 2, 2, 5 missiles [BASE, POD, HYDRA]. Each projectile fires for 5 seconds instead of 1.25. Ending up dealing 3200 damage for Gorgon over the duration of 5 seconds. And 2000 times 6 for Hydra. The damage is now also HE instead of ENERGY

Gazer now has 800 range, but the beam does twice as much damage. Gazer pushing mechanic removed

Squall now does 200 energy damage instead of 100 kinetic for every projectile. Turning stats increased to make it miss the target less

Hurricane now deploys 15 projectiles instead of 7

Swarmer deploys 8 instead of 4 projectiles per salvo. And has 120 ammo instead of 80. DOES NOT AFFECT TALON VARIANT

Locust now launchers projectiles 50% faster and has 33% more ammo capacity

Annihilator rockets are now launched at 100 instead of 50 units. And accelerate to 500 speed instead of 400. Additionally they have 50% more ammo. Base Annihilator now has 80 ammo instead of 50. POD now has 150. And fighter Annihilator now has 8 instead of 4

Salamander now does 500 HE damage

END OF MISSILE CHANGES

Beams have been thoroughly overhauled in damage capabilities and general impact so that they are less spammy. More difficult to utilise. Whilst at the same time ridiculously impactful in combat

Phase Lance has 800 range but 1 flux efficiency

Graviton Beam, Tactical Laser, HIL, IR Autolance range is now 800 but DPS is now twice as high at same flux efficiency. Meaning HIL now does 1k HE damage per second at 800 flux cost for example.

Graviton pushing mechanic removed. As it was too frustrating to deal with and had no counter of any kind

Tachyon Lance, Ion Beam do twice as much EMP damage instead, but do not gain flux costs

PD WEAPON CHANGES

HMG now does twice as much damage per projectile. Topping at whopping 640 kinetic DPS.
Now has 400 range instead of 450
LMG, DLMG range increased to 400
Both HMG and LMG were PD weapons that failed at their job. And only existed in fringe melee SO builds. They are now more effective at both melee builds and PD role. Being far less fatal to ships when the autofit decides to equip them. They are however still less effective at PD than Vulcan than Flak Cannon. But with this alternative role it's not as big of a deal

Vulcan range increased to 500. This does affect Talons
Dual Flak Cannon now has 500 range and does 200 fragmentation damage per projectile at 0.66 firing cooldown. Meaning it does 33% more damage than Flak Cannon and has the same range. As previously Flak Cannon had 500 range and Dual Flak Cannon had 400
These weapons funnily enough did their job well enough. But with the incredible spread, Vulcan could have 500 range without it feeling too bad to fight against.
Comically, this change hasn't been motivated by LMG necessarily being stronger. It was motivated by a thought that Mora carriers should be able to use Vulcans without ITU

Paladin PD System now shoots a burst that lasts 0.4 seconds instead of 0.1. Meaning it will deal less fragmentation damage and more energy damage at slower charge spending. This does mean it has higher long-term DPS than Autopulse
Mining Laser, LR PD Laser, PD Laser damage doubled. Flux efficiency remains the same
Burst PD now fires a beam for 0.6 seconds instead of 0.3 (idea taken from a forum post). High Delay Burst PD used by Sparks now uses the same damage values
With these changes PD Lasers will now finally be worth equipping. And goodly so. Cause Front-Shield Conversion is no longer as strong

END OF PD WEAPON CHANGES

ENERGY WEAPON CHANGES

Ion Cannon now does 50 instead of 40 damage at 0.6 flux efficiency. It now additionally has 600 range. Claws are now equipped with the standard Ion Cannon variant. Meaning each of them does 100 DPS
Ion Pulser also has 600 range now
IR Pulse Laser efficiency reduced to 1. Fire rate increased to 4 per second. Meaning it has 200 DPS. Fighters are now equipped with this variant of the weapon instead of a high fire delay one. Including Lux. It now has 600 range
Pulse Laser now fires at efficiency 1 and with 4 shots per second. Ending up at 400 DPS

AMB is no longer ammo restricted and has 500 range instead of 400
Gigacannon and Kinetic Blaster damage doubled. Kinetic Blaster now has 600 range. Base value increased to make them sell for lots of credits
Heavy Blaster now does 600 damage instead of 500 at same flux spending. Meaning it now has 1.2 flux efficiency

Mining Blaster reverted to its old form with the current damage passive. Now does 400 ENERGY every second at 500 flux with additional 100 pure anti-armour damage on top. Should be less confusing to AI. Reverted description

END OF ENERGY WEAPON CHANGES

FACTION DOCTRINES

Reduced the frequency of Moras and Condors in Hegemony fleets by 50%
Gave Hegemony Apogees, Sunders, Hammerheads and Manticores
Gave Hegemony Heavy Machine Gun, Hellbore, Salamander and Salamander Pod, Autopulse and Heavy Burst  PD
Changed Hegemony doctrine to have less officers and more ships
Changed Hegemony doctrine to have smaller ships

Lion’s Guard now has competent officers
Lion’s Guard will now have more smaller ships

Gave GCR Gemini, Drover, Wayfarer, Enforcer and Dominator
Gave GCR Heavy Machine Gun, Hephaestus AG, Locust, Squall, Graviton Beam, PD Laser and LR PD Laser
Made GCR doctrine destroyer-focused

Made Mercenary doctrine have less ships so that they aren’t ridiculously strong
Made Mercenaries spec into Cruisers instead of Capital Ship spam

Gave PL Tempests and Omens
Gave PL Vulcan PD, Dual Flak Cannons, Velociraptor, Gauss, Autopulse and Plasma Cannons (to help out High Tech stations)
Made their fleet doctrine Capital Ship spam
Cruiser spam instead

Remnants will now have 3 admiral skills instead of 2. They will now use Electronic Warfare again

Gave Sindrian Diktat Wolves, Shrikes, Furies, Champions, Herons, Drovers, Shades, Afflictors, Harbingers and Dooms. NOTE THEY WILL NEVER DEPLOY ANY CARRIERS OR PHASE SHIPS EXCEPT BY RANDOM CHANCE VERY RARELY AS THEIR FLEET DOCTRINE IN THOSE IS SET TO ZERO
Gave Sindrian Diktat Heavy Blaster, Ion Beam, Plasma Cannons, Guardian PD, Heavy MG, Burst PD, Heavy Burst PD and AMB.
Gave Sindrian Diktat Wasps, Cobras, Longbows, Daggers and Tridents. These will be sold now on markets and will help out their space stations
Made Diktat doctrine frigate and destroyer focused

Gave Tri-Tachyon Light MG, Dual Light MG, Heavy MG (to help out their space stations. No, giving your entire Midline station Needlers instead of PD is not a good idea)
Gave Tri-Tachyon competent officers
Made their doctrine destroyer focused

Doubled cost, DP and specialised cargo stat of all civilian ships. Crig received huge armour and hull durability buff instead. Those include Valkyrie, Phantom and Revenant in spite of not being civilian. But you get the point

Gave Lumen and Glimmer 5 more OP. Reworked variants

Doubled Enforcer's and Dominator's acceleration stats

Reworked Grendel to its vanilla form but with higher armour and more OP. Gave it burn drive instead of ammo feed

Increased Gemini's DP cost reworked its variants to use bombers.

Reworked Apex's variants.

Reworked Grendel, Heron, Mora variants

Reworked Legion variants

Reverted Invictus having higher OP. But brought back its 40k health

Generic - small armies, average officers, average quality (Sindrian Diktat, LG, TT, Indie, Pathers, etc.)
Elite - slightly above small armies, stronger officers, poor quality (PL, Hegemony, GCR)
Elite - small armies, elite officers, elite ship quality (Mercenaries only)
